newsitem.title: BURMA: Burma says only 63 detainees still being held.
newsitem.headline: Burma says only 63 detainees still being held.

text.p: Burma said on Monday that only 63 detainees were still being held after the crackdown in late September on supporters of Aung San Suu Kyi's National League for Democracy (NLD) party.
Authorities had detained 573 people to thwart a planned NLD party congress at Suu Kyi's home.
A government official told Reuters that the 159 NLD members who were detained had all been released, and only 63 democracy supporters were still being held in custody.
"The remaining persons held are also expected to be released soon," he said.
Police continued to man checkpoints and bar public access to University Avenue, the road running past Suu Kyi's residence.
The checkpoints set up on September 26 also have prevented Suu Kyi from holding her regular weekend public gatherings in front of her home.
Suu Kyi was not available for comment.
